caption:
An assessment that cannot be checked is an opinion with better graphics.

We grade confidence as confirmed, assessed, or unknown, and we say which is which. We log the pass, the timestamp, and the reasoning behind every call, so a reviewer can walk back through it after the fact — including in a courtroom, if it comes to that. That discipline is slower than issuing a verdict. It is also the only version of this work that holds up when someone checks it.

The Numan reach-monitoring array flagged the September 2022 flood signature four days ahead of the official warning. In the 2021 control year, with no flood building, the same array stayed quiet. We publish the quiet year with the same weight as the catch, because a system that only shows its hits is not evidence, it's marketing.

We do not claim coverage we don't have, confidence we haven't earned, or results we can't trace. That is the whole method.
